_comment: Customer reviews are static and human-curated. ONLY add a review from a real customer who gave permission to publish it. Never invent a name, city, rating, date or text. Entries marked "placeholder": true are layout fixtures: they are excluded from every rendered section and from aggregateRating markup, and the PRODUCTION BUILD FAILS if any placeholder is still present. Production builds must contain only real, permissioned entries.
